The review was completed afterwards on the merged head `1e489533f1` in a detached compare worktree and is recorded here so the card carries its verdict.

- Diff read: one file, 5 insertions / 5 deletions, `platform-readings.md` at 388 lines (ceiling 388, headroom 0, no ratchet edit). Lines 26–30 state the registered-driver reading (merge-ort applies a registered driver; registration is per clone via the prepare step and the server runs none; a driver's exit 0 defers the content judgement; the probe is a driver-less bare clone; the `-c merge.os-regen.driver=` override is banned), and the older restatement under 读数陷阱 is deleted, so the mechanism has one site.
- #15647 §2 item 2 (a control reproduces the condition under test) rides as the first clause of the probe line, as ruled in batch #65.
- Open question A (keep the queue-section site, delete the trap-section pair) is accepted as delivered: the reading sits beside the command it governs.
- The dispatch sub-premise that SKILL.md spelled the two-leg `-c` form was false; the only carrier was this ledger's own line 353, deleted by the PR. No follow-up card. The seat's own flight briefs that prescribed the two-leg form (V, X, C3) were corrected by message; C3 and X were told to probe from a driver-less bare clone.
- Cards #16457 and #15647 closed by the merge; `pm:dispatched` and assignee stripped on both with read-back.
